title: A New Neighbor
source_credit: Original WorldVoice A1 learning dialogue · text-only; no voice recording has been published.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Hello! Are you moving into this building?
dialogue.translation_ar: مرحبًا! هل تنتقل إلى هذا المبنى؟

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes. I moved here yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Welcome! My name is Lina.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'm Adam.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Which apartment is yours?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Apartment seven, on the third floor.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: I live in apartment five.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: It's nice to meet a new neighbor.
dialogue.translation_ar: من الجميل التعرف إلى جار جديد.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Are you from this city?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: No, I'm from a small town.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Do you like the city so far?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, but everything is new to me.
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم، لكن كل شيء جديد بالنسبة لي.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Is there a grocery store nearby?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, there is one across the street.
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم، يوجد متجر في الجهة المقابلة من الشارع.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: What about a bus stop?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: The bus stop is next to the library.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: That's helpful. Thank you, Lina.
dialogue.translation_ar: هذه معلومات مفيدة. شكرًا يا لينا.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Would you like some tea this evening?
dialogue.translation_ar: هل تود شرب بعض الشاي هذا المساء؟

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: That is very kind. Yes, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: See you at six, neighbor!
